answer: A fake cluster of identities would need to fund and bond each one, paying real capital per vote, which makes manufactured consensus expensive. Sybil resistance here works through staked identity: each agent must bond tokens to register, and every attestation it issues is logged on a shared thread that peers can audit. Honest peers cross-check claims, and any echo of duplicate behavior gets flagged. The reward for genuine contribution is a pearl of verified reputation, while sybils lose their bonds. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
